days.headline: Bandipur Forest Canopy Drive -> Wayanad Coffee-Estate Villa

stops.title: Morning Forest Corridor Drive: Mysuru -> Sultan Bathery
stops.location_label: NH766 · Bandipur & Muthanga Tiger Reserves (115 km)
stops.description: After Radisson's Super Breakfast, exit southern Mysuru straight onto NH766. Cruise slowly through 30 km of Bandipur–Muthanga forest canopy.
stops.kid_note: High Jeep Meridian windows give effortless roadside sightings of spotted deer, peacocks, langurs, and wild elephants — no formal safari required.
stops.insider_tip: Keep speed <=40 km/h over forest humps; stopping or feeding wildlife is strictly fined.

stops.title: Highway Family Lunch at The Wilton Restaurant
stops.description: Spacious, spotless AC family landmark right as you enter Wayanad.
stops.dietary_note: Must-order: Malabar Chicken/Mutton Biryani, Tawa Fish Fry, and crisp North/South Indian Veg platters.

stops.title: Check-in at The Sattva Grove (StayVista)
stops.description: Settle into your 2 BHK villa. Kids get room to roam, swim, and play board games.
stops.kid_note: Expansive private lawn, swimming pool facing Chembra Peak, indoor board games, and dedicated caretaker/cook.

stops.title: Guided Coffee, Black Pepper & Cardamom Estate Walk
stops.description: Easy first-evening plantation stroll seeing Arabica/Robusta coffee berries, pepper vines, and cocoa pods, followed by homestyle Kerala dinner at the villa.
stops.dietary_note: Villa dinner: Hot Appams + Vegetable Stew + Nadan Chicken Roast.

days.headline: Edakkal Stone-Age Climb, Phantom Rock & 1980's Kerala Feast

stops.title: Moderate Climb #1: Edakkal Caves (Neolithic Petroglyphs)
stops.description: Steep paved hill walk + ~300 rock-cut steps and iron ladders wedged between giant split boulders revealing 6,000-year-old Stone Age carvings.
stops.kid_note: Thrilling boulder-cleft climb for ages 8 & 10 with panoramic Wayanad plateau views at the top.
stops.insider_tip: Arriving by 9:15 AM beats Christmas-week ticket queues by 60+ minutes and avoids midday sun.

stops.title: Short Rock Scramble: Phantom Rock (Cheengeri Mala)
stops.description: Natural skull-shaped metamorphic rock formation with gentle, grippy boulder slabs and sweeping valley breezes.
stops.kid_note: Easy 20-minute scramble with great family photo vantage points.

stops.title: Signature Kerala Feast at 1980's – A Nostalgic Restaurant
stops.description: Set inside a vintage Kerala ancestral home with 80s memorabilia and warm family hospitality.
stops.dietary_note: Veg + Non-Veg: Banana-leaf Kerala Sadhya meals, Meen Pollichathu (fish roasted in banana leaf), Nadan Chicken Curry, Prawn Roast & Sulaimani tea.

stops.title: Uravu Indigenous Bamboo Craft Village
stops.description: Calm open-air artisan centre where kids watch craftspeople turn giant Wayanad bamboo into architecture, toys, and puzzles — zero theme-park crowds.
stops.insider_tip: Pick up hand-carved bamboo brain-teaser puzzles for the kids for the drive home.

days.headline: Soochipara Waterfall Steps, Tea Ridges, En Ooru & Villa BBQ

stops.title: Moderate Climb #2: Soochipara (Sentinel Rock) Waterfalls
stops.description: Scenic ~1.2 km stone-stepped forest descent & climb back up (25 mins each way through tea estates and deciduous canopy) to a dramatic 200-ft 3-tiered waterfall.
stops.kid_note: Great leg-stretching forest step climb (no water rides). Lighter backup 15 mins away: Kanthanpara Waterfalls.
stops.insider_tip: Carry reusable metal water bottles — forest checkpost prohibits single-use plastic bottles.

stops.title: Meppadi & Arapetta Tea-Estate Ridge Walk
stops.description: Gentle walk along manicured green tea-picker ridges framed by mist-draped Chembra Peak.

stops.title: Rustic Village Lunch at ClayHut Restaurant
stops.description: Cozy open-air clay and bamboo huts tucked inside lush greenery.
stops.dietary_note: Homestyle Kerala Veg curries, coconut-oil tawa fish fry, country chicken roast & flaky Malabar parottas.

stops.title: En Ooru Tribal Heritage Village & Lakkidi Viewpoint
stops.description: Walk an open-air hilltop tribal hamlet showcasing indigenous mud-and-thatch architecture, tribal crafts, and sweeping valley vistas, ending with sunset over Thamarassery Ghat.
stops.insider_tip: 7:30 PM Christmas Eve back at your private villa: pre-order a garden bonfire + Veg/Chicken/Fish BBQ under the stars.

days.headline: Slow Villa Morning -> Early-Afternoon Return to Radisson Mysore

stops.title: Unhurried Christmas Morning at the Villa
stops.description: Sleep in, enjoy slow Christmas breakfast on the veranda, one final dip in the pool, and pack at an easy family pace.

stops.title: Early-Afternoon Return Lunch at Mathai's Restocafe
stops.description: Airy modern family restocafe right on NH766 before entering the forest checkpost.
stops.dietary_note: Pastas/continental kid favorites alongside Kerala Veg & Non-Veg specials (Alt: Hotel Udupi for crisp dosas).

stops.title: Daylight Forest Drive Back to Radisson Blu Mysore
stops.location_label: Sultan Bathery -> Muthanga -> Bandipur -> Mysuru (115 km)

days.headline: 2 PM Koramangala Rollout -> Radisson Blu Mysore Rest Anchor

stops.title: Expressway Cruise: Koramangala -> Mysuru
stops.location_label: NICE Road -> NH275 Bengaluru–Mysuru Expressway (162 km)
stops.description: Roll out of Koramangala at 2:00 PM via Electronic City ramp onto NICE Road -> Cloverleaf -> NH275 Expressway -> Mysuru Outer Ring Road East.

stops.title: Check-in & Pool Unwind at Radisson Blu Plaza Mysore
stops.location_label: MG Road · Race Course / Chamundi Foothills
stops.description: Relaxed hotel evening with Chamundi Hills view pool — zero city sightseeing detours as requested.
stops.kid_note: Kids aged 8 & 10 unwind at the pool after the 3-hour drive.

stops.title: Family Dinner at Spring (Radisson On-Site)
stops.description: Effortless multi-cuisine buffet & live grills right inside the hotel so nobody steps back into traffic.
stops.dietary_note: Full Veg + Non-Veg spread (South Indian, kebabs, pastas, desserts).

days.headline: Bandipur Forest Canopy Drive -> Wayanad Coffee-Estate Villa

stops.title: Morning Forest Corridor Drive: Mysuru -> Sultan Bathery
stops.location_label: NH766 · Bandipur & Muthanga Tiger Reserves (115 km)
stops.description: After Radisson's Super Breakfast, exit southern Mysuru straight onto NH766. Cruise slowly through 30 km of Bandipur–Muthanga forest canopy.
stops.kid_note: High Jeep Meridian windows give effortless roadside sightings of spotted deer, peacocks, langurs, and wild elephants — no formal safari required.
stops.insider_tip: Keep speed <=40 km/h over forest humps; stopping or feeding wildlife is strictly fined.

stops.title: Highway Family Lunch at The Wilton Restaurant
stops.description: Spacious, spotless AC family landmark right as you enter Wayanad.
stops.dietary_note: Must-order: Malabar Chicken/Mutton Biryani, Tawa Fish Fry, and crisp North/South Indian Veg platters.

stops.title: Check-in at "Brookview" Tranquil Coffee Chalet
stops.description: Settle into your 2 BHK villa. Kids get room to roam, swim, and play board games.
stops.kid_note: River-rapids nature trail inside the estate, coffee & pepper bush walks, campfire pit, and pool.

stops.title: Guided Coffee, Black Pepper & Cardamom Estate Walk
stops.description: Easy first-evening plantation stroll seeing Arabica/Robusta coffee berries, pepper vines, and cocoa pods, followed by homestyle Kerala dinner at the villa.
stops.dietary_note: Villa dinner: Hot Appams + Vegetable Stew + Nadan Chicken Roast.

days.headline: Edakkal Stone-Age Climb, Phantom Rock & 1980's Kerala Feast

stops.title: Moderate Climb #1: Edakkal Caves (Neolithic Petroglyphs)
stops.description: Steep paved hill walk + ~300 rock-cut steps and iron ladders wedged between giant split boulders revealing 6,000-year-old Stone Age carvings.
stops.kid_note: Thrilling boulder-cleft climb for ages 8 & 10 with panoramic Wayanad plateau views at the top.
stops.insider_tip: Arriving by 9:15 AM beats Christmas-week ticket queues by 60+ minutes and avoids midday sun.

stops.title: Short Rock Scramble: Phantom Rock (Cheengeri Mala)
stops.description: Natural skull-shaped metamorphic rock formation with gentle, grippy boulder slabs and sweeping valley breezes.
stops.kid_note: Easy 20-minute scramble with great family photo vantage points.

stops.title: Signature Kerala Feast at 1980's – A Nostalgic Restaurant
stops.description: Set inside a vintage Kerala ancestral home with 80s memorabilia and warm family hospitality.
stops.dietary_note: Veg + Non-Veg: Banana-leaf Kerala Sadhya meals, Meen Pollichathu (fish roasted in banana leaf), Nadan Chicken Curry, Prawn Roast & Sulaimani tea.

stops.title: Uravu Indigenous Bamboo Craft Village
stops.description: Calm open-air artisan centre where kids watch craftspeople turn giant Wayanad bamboo into architecture, toys, and puzzles — zero theme-park crowds.
stops.insider_tip: Pick up hand-carved bamboo brain-teaser puzzles for the kids for the drive home.

days.headline: Soochipara Waterfall Steps, Tea Ridges, En Ooru & Villa BBQ

stops.title: Moderate Climb #2: Soochipara (Sentinel Rock) Waterfalls
stops.description: Scenic ~1.2 km stone-stepped forest descent & climb back up (25 mins each way through tea estates and deciduous canopy) to a dramatic 200-ft 3-tiered waterfall.
stops.kid_note: Great leg-stretching forest step climb (no water rides). Lighter backup 15 mins away: Kanthanpara Waterfalls.
stops.insider_tip: Carry reusable metal water bottles — forest checkpost prohibits single-use plastic bottles.

stops.title: Meppadi & Arapetta Tea-Estate Ridge Walk
stops.description: Gentle walk along manicured green tea-picker ridges framed by mist-draped Chembra Peak.

stops.title: Rustic Village Lunch at ClayHut Restaurant
stops.description: Cozy open-air clay and bamboo huts tucked inside lush greenery.
stops.dietary_note: Homestyle Kerala Veg curries, coconut-oil tawa fish fry, country chicken roast & flaky Malabar parottas.

stops.title: En Ooru Tribal Heritage Village & Lakkidi Viewpoint
stops.description: Walk an open-air hilltop tribal hamlet showcasing indigenous mud-and-thatch architecture, tribal crafts, and sweeping valley vistas, ending with sunset over Thamarassery Ghat.
stops.insider_tip: 7:30 PM Christmas Eve back at your private villa: pre-order a garden bonfire + Veg/Chicken/Fish BBQ under the stars.

days.headline: Slow Villa Morning -> Early-Afternoon Return to Radisson Mysore

stops.title: Unhurried Christmas Morning at the Villa
stops.description: Sleep in, enjoy slow Christmas breakfast on the veranda, one final dip in the pool, and pack at an easy family pace.

stops.title: Early-Afternoon Return Lunch at Mathai's Restocafe
stops.description: Airy modern family restocafe right on NH766 before entering the forest checkpost.
stops.dietary_note: Pastas/continental kid favorites alongside Kerala Veg & Non-Veg specials (Alt: Hotel Udupi for crisp dosas).

stops.title: Daylight Forest Drive Back to Radisson Blu Mysore
stops.location_label: Sultan Bathery -> Muthanga -> Bandipur -> Mysuru (115 km)
stops.description: Cross Muthanga & Bandipur ~1:35–2:45 PM in bright daylight, pulling into Radisson Blu Plaza Mysore by 4:30 PM for a festive Christmas evening buffet & deep rest.

days.headline: Unhurried Mysuru Lunch -> Afternoon Cruise Home to Koramangala

stops.title: Lazy Radisson Morning & Super Breakfast
stops.description: Sleep in, enjoy the full breakfast spread and pool/lounge, and check out at 12:00 PM.

stops.title: Farewell Lunch at The Old House (or Hotel RRR)
stops.description: Leafy heritage bungalow cafe serving wood-fired pizzas, handmade pastas & salads kids love — or pick Hotel RRR for iconic banana-leaf biryani & veg meals.
stops.dietary_note: Both Veg & Non-Veg; light and comfortable right before the afternoon highway run.

stops.title: Post-Lunch Expressway Return to Koramangala
stops.location_label: NH275 Expressway -> NICE Road -> Electronic City -> Koramangala
stops.description: Smooth Saturday afternoon cruise back home on NH275, arriving in Koramangala by ~5:15–5:30 PM.
